reason: My guests already follow me on Instagram and message me on WhatsApp, and that costs me nothing. I already pay for Wox and a card terminal, so another system plus another per-transaction fee is a hard sell, even with three months free.
objection: Why pay a third system and an extra fee on every bill when Instagram already fills my weekends? And my waiters would have to explain QR payment to every table.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from a Tbilisi restaurant like mine that it brought regulars back and the payment fee is no higher than my card terminal's.
